headline: Indian Rupee Holds Steady Near 94.75 as RBI Intervention Offsets Crude Pressures
summary: The Indian rupee traded slightly higher against the U.S. dollar as Reserve Bank of India interventions helped offset headwinds from elevated global crude oil prices.
why: Central bank interventions in foreign exchange markets help manage excessive currency volatility and mitigate the imported inflationary impact of expensive commodities.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Central bank defense measures support the currency against depreciation pressures from high oil import costs.
